positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceAsAsset
positions.frame: when intelligence is acquired, what is the durable asset and what is merely commodity infrastructure — owned versus rented, substrate versus perspective?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same unhedged, aphoristic antithesis — technical vocabulary (owned/rented, substrate/asset) compressed into a flat, unqualified maxim delivered with calm, settled confidence. Each draws the line between what is acquired-and-discarded and what is acquired-and-kept, appealing to autonomy and self-enhancement and arguing by logical contrast rather than argument-from-evidence. src-2 states the categorical distinction (owned vs. rented); src-3 supplies the specific instance of it (substrate as commodity, perspective as kept asset) — one directional read spanning both, with no tension between them.
